purpose: Driver-side independent confirmation of the one-time Grok Q7.1 NO-GO audit; read-only checks only.

finite_hull_can_be_promoted.method: Built a finite atlas, passed its own lower_enclosures/upper_enclosures back as continuous_enclosures, then evaluated.
finite_hull_can_be_promoted.interpretation: A sampled finite hull is accepted as a continuous certificate; this is an invalid promotion under the Q7 plan.

sigma_zero_topology_merge.method: Two sigma=0 sources were placed in the same nearest grid cell with different subcell positions.
sigma_zero_topology_merge.interpretation: The Q7 topology key drops the zero-scale unit-TSC subcell response and merges distinct responses.

arbitrary_rank_23_basis.method: Passed an arbitrary random (23,M) basis to evaluate_atlas.

fail_closed_fallback.method: Evaluated without allow_uncertified_finite_enclosure and compared with sourcewise Q1.

nuance.periodic_seam: target_cells encode some seam behavior, but there is no explicit seam-regime certificate or dedicated separation test; treat Grok's auditability concern as valid.
nuance.scope: No Q7.2, full N192, posterior, IC, PM/HOP, zoom, GPFS or Slurm work was started.

decision: The NO-GO is technically justified. Corrective implementation and re-audit are required before Q7.2.
